title: A resource-specific access-policy pilot
method: Synthetic forty-case fixture with expected decisions defined in advance. Report false denials and false allows separately. Fixture success does not establish that every production identity or threat has been covered.
alt: A resource-specific access-policy pilot: Expected permitted 32 test cases, Correctly permitted 31 test cases, Expected denied 8 test cases, Correctly denied 8 test cases. Illustrative inputs.
